about: The range of a catalogue scene's default Scene size (CatalogScene.scale). Two writers must agree: packages/scenes/src/catalog.ts readScene and apps/api/admin.py clean_scene. packages/scenes/test/catalog.test.ts and apps/api/tests/test_admin.py both read this table; tools/bench/test/scene-default.test.ts keeps min/max equal to the pilot's [ ] range (packages/prefs SCALE_MIN/MAX). kept: the value the entry keeps, null: the field is dropped.
